title: Donning and Doffing PPE
description: Do your employees find it difficult to remember the order in which they should put on and take off PPE?
body:
Do your employees find it difficult to remember the order in which they should put on and take off PPE?

The recommended order for donning items is not the same as for doffing PPE used for protection from bloodborne pathogens or in isolation precautions settings. Use the following tip:

Don PPE from the bottom up:

* Gown

* Mask

* Goggles

* Gloves (when raised above the head)

Doff PPE in alphabetical order:

* Gloves

* Goggles

* Gown

* Mask

Staff members may respond positively to having a graphic/mnemonic reminder at each PPE dispensing station.
